lines.text: Many learners say: I want that you help me.
Better: I want you to help me.
To! I want you to come.

data.wrong: I want that you help me.
data.right: I want you to help me.

native.tip: Em inglês dizemos “want you to”, sem “that”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I want that you help me.”. O certo é “I want you to help me.”. Em português usamos “quero que você”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “to”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I want that you”?
en.tip: In English we say “want you to”, with no “that”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I want that you help me.”. The right way is “I want you to help me.”. In Portuguese we say “quero que você”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
